blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – In lobbying for a bigger Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) fund in 2027, Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Wednesday invoked “brotherly love” between Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian and Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian. “Doon po sa binabaan ang budget ng AICS, hindi po ba malungkot ito… Hindi ba pwedeng pakiusapan si SP (Senate President)? Brotherly love?” Padilla said during Sen. Risa Hontiveros’ endorsement of the proposed P253.3 billion budget for the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) for fiscal year 2027.
